thread:
nora: Running into weird failures in the Python sampleapp onboarding. The embed route works with curl but fails when using the SDK. Frontend shows an error: "400 Bad Request: invalid input shape".

nora: curl example that succeeds:
``` 
curl -X POST \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"text-embed-001","input":["first","second"]}' \ 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
```

nora: Python SDK call (from sampleapp) that errors:
```
client = RedwoodClient(token=TOKEN)
resp = client.embeddings.create(model="text-embed-001", documents=["first","second"])
# -> APIError: 400 invalid input shape
```

evan: looks like the SDK expects `documents` (list[str]) while REST docs show `input` as the canonical param. That's a parity bug. Do we have a mapping layer?

ci-bot: opened issue RED-PI-321 (python-sdk): embeddings param name mismatch (documents vs input). Link: https://git.redwood/dev/python-sdk/issues/321 :spiral_note_pad:

mel: also noticed another subtlety while debugging: our Python transport normalizes header names to lowercase before sending. On some on-prem proxies that use a strict matcher, `idempotency-key` (lowercase) is ignored and duplicates are processed on retry. The sampleapp uses a one-off idempotency header for onboarding jobs, so retries mean repeated downstream calls.

nora: yep saw that in logs. When the app retries we got duplicate profile creates in downstream system. In curl I set `Idempotency-Key: abc123` and it was honored; via SDK the header became `idempotency-key` and the proxy ignored it.

oss-team-bot: label(s) applied: sdk/python, bug, onboarding, headers

evan: plan: 1) patch the python client to accept both `input` and `documents` as aliases for embeddings.create; 2) preserve header casing in the low-level transport (send headers as provided by caller); 3) add an integration test that POSTs embeddings against staging proxy with Idempotency-Key and asserts only one downstream side-effect.

mel: short-term workaround for sampleapp: call REST directly with requests and the canonical `input` body, and explicitly set `Idempotency-Key` header. I'll add a small fallback in the sampleapp README so new users don't hit this.

nora: thanks. I pushed a tiny docs PR with the curl REST fallback and a code snippet for requests.

evan: ETA: will open a patch branch in the python-sdk repo today. Hoping to cut a patch release tomorrow after CI. I'll post the PR link here and add the integration test in the same change.

nora: appreciate it 64f. This blocked a hackathon demo, so higher priority from my side.

mel: noted. marking P1 and will escalate if no fix by EOD tomorrow.
